caption: A young woman with long curly red hair, a black wide-brimmed hat, round glasses and a white checkered top stands centered in a greenhouse. Rows of green tomato plants and pale metal support rails blur behind her. She holds a black tablet in front of her chest, her left hand supporting it from below, her gaze fixed downward toward the tablet with a faint smile. At first her right index finger hovers near the upper-left edge of the tablet, making small movements. Her eyes and head shift subtly as she reads, and the view around her changes slightly. Then the raised right hand moves out of view, leaving only the supporting left hand visible. She keeps looking down at the tablet, her expression calm, as the blurred greenery behind her remains softly out of focus.
